hypotheses.L0_hybrid_recomposition_is_exact: At every audited boundary, selecting counterfactual residual, embedding, and value bus reproduces the native counterfactual logits to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.L1_spelling_reaches_boundary_state: By Layer 8, the latest-boundary residual alone has at least 0.50 projection onto the full spelling-family effect.
hypotheses.L2_other_variables_reach_destination_sta: By Layer 12, destination-only residual patches have at least 0.50 projection for at least two of sentiment, gender, and tense.
hypotheses.L3_full_residual_internalizes_transfer: By Layer 12, the full residual field alone has at least 0.80 projection for all four transferable families.
hypotheses.L4_external_carriers_decline: At Layer 12, neither embedding-only nor value-bus-only projection exceeds 0.20 for any transferable family.
hypotheses.L5_spelling_boundary_path_is_exceptional: At Layer 8, spelling latest-boundary projection exceeds every other family's by at least 0.20.
